questions.question: How often do you purchase fresh fruit for your household?
On average, what percentage of the fresh fruit you buy ends up being thrown away?
Have you ever thrown away fruit specifically because it went from "unripe" to "spoiled/rotten" faster than you expected?
Which of the following scenarios has caused you to throw away fruit?
labels: I bought it unripe, forgot about it, and it rotted on the counter.
It felt hard/unripe when I checked it, but it was already rotten on the inside.
I bought it unripe expecting it to sweeten, but it just spoiled instead (e.g., berries, citrus).
I intentionally waited for it to ripen, but the window of "perfect ripeness" was too short.

questions.question: Which fruits do you most frequently misjudge the ripening time for, leading to waste?
questions.note: This question allows multiple fruit selections, so totals can exceed the number of respondents.

questions.question: How confident are you in your ability to predict exactly which day a piece of unripe fruit will be ready to eat?

Before today, were you aware of the difference between "climacteric" fruits (which keep ripening after harvest, like bananas) and "non-climacteric" fruits (which do not ripen after harvest, like strawberries)?
labels: No, I did not know this.
I had heard of it, but wasn't entirely sure.

questions.question: How do you typically feel when you have to throw away fruit because you missed the ripening window? (Rate from 1 to 5, where 1 is "Indifferent" and 5 is "Highly Frustrated/Guilty")
When shopping, do you actively look for fruit that is already perfectly ripe, or do you prefer to buy it unripe so it lasts longer?
labels: I prefer buying a mix of ripe and unripe fruit.
I always look for perfectly ripe, ready-to-eat fruit.
I purposefully buy unripe fruit to prevent it from spoiling too quickly.

questions.question: Would you pay a small premium (e.g., 5-10% more) for fruit that features technology (like smart scanning or specialized packaging) ensuring a predictable, guaranteed ripening window?
labels: Yes, if it is a fruit I waste often (like bananas)
No, I would not pay more
